title: config value int beyond i64 is rewritten as a float; state parse saturates at i64::MAX
right_side: legacy (Python ints are unbounded; the file must contain the exact digits, state.graphics.fov must be 9223372036854775808)
severity: wrong file content on disk (config.ini gets 9.223372036854776e+18) + wrong response
culprit: config_ini.rs ConfigValue::from_json (as_i64 else as_f64) + get_int/get_float (trunc() as i64) + serde_json number parsing (needs the `arbitrary_precision` feature or a string-preserving Int variant)
suggested_fix: keep integer literals as text/i128-or-bigint in ConfigValue and parse state ints with a saturating-free path (Python int(float(x)) of huge values is itself a big int)
